{{Top}}
The '''pincer maneuver''', sometimes referred to as a '''pincer''', was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] tactic used to entrap a target [[Starship/Legends|starship]] between attacking [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] battled against forces of [[Thrawn's confederation]] several times<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref><ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' and ''[[The Last Command]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]</ref> when they utilized pincer maneuvers.<ref name="HTTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pincer maneuver first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[1992]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="HTTE" />
